Opportunities for career development and skills advancement.  Stable employment with an established Australian manufacturing company. Read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and production instructions.  Perform machining operations to produce precision components.  Select and change cutting tools, fixtures, and machine settings as required.  Conduct quality checks using measuring equipment such as micrometers, verniers, and gauges. Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.   About Company    Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is an Australian manufacturer based in Brunswick East, Victoria, specialising in vinyl record production and precision-engineered tooling for the global vinyl record industry. Established in 2013, the company combines advanced CNC machining, engineering, and manufacturing expertise to design and produce high-quality molds, tooling, spare parts, and vinyl records for customers in Australia and overseas. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and quality, Zenith Vinyl continues to support the growing global demand for premium vinyl manufacturing solutions.
